folkways_updater.config.title: Folkways Updater
folkways_updater.config.subtitle: Base install: Core + Vanilla + LDLib2
folkways_updater.config.exit_help: Downloaded updates install after fully quitting the game.
folkways_updater.config.local_help: Pause only Folkways and dependency checks, downloads and replacement. Updater self-updates remain independent. Legacy markers and a manually installed updater cannot enable this mode.
folkways_updater.config.network_help: GitHub verification APIs and JARs use this direct/mirror order with fallback. Mirror mode trusts github.davisye.cn to relay verification metadata.
folkways_updater.config.commands_help: Enable /restart and /shutdown for permission level 4. Full client restart is not supported; dedicated servers restart after saving.
folkways_updater.config.module_help: Optional integration requiring %s. Compatible installed prerequisites are reused; conflicting manual files are retained.
folkways_updater.config.module_missing: Select to download missing %s and its required dependencies together. They install after the game exits.
folkways_updater.config.region_help: Used only by Region hint network mode; no IP lookup is sent.
folkways_updater.config.check_help: Save and check this source now. If busy, check the latest selection next. Installation requires fully quitting.
folkways_updater.config.load_error: Cannot read config.json. Repair the file before saving.
folkways_updater.config.busy: Saved; the latest selection will be checked immediately after the active check.
folkways_updater.config.save_error: Save failed. Check config.json and file permissions, then retry.
folkways_updater.status.idle: Automatic check starts 15 seconds after launch.
folkways_updater.status.checking: Checking and verifying downloads in the background...
folkways_updater.status.local: Local development: only Folkways and dependency updates are paused.
folkways_updater.status.config_error: Cannot read updater settings; current files retained.
folkways_updater.status.self_error: Updater self-check unavailable; current updater retained.
folkways_updater.status.folkways_error: Folkways check failed. Check official API access, selected channel, installed files and dependencies; current files retained.
folkways_updater.status.existing_protect: Existing Folkways files are unmanaged. Use “Take over existing & update” in Additional settings to authorize once.
folkways_updater.status.signed_protected: Existing signed-source ownership is protected; restore its manifest before updating.
folkways_updater.status.folkways_ready: Folkways and dependencies are downloaded; fully quit to install.
folkways_updater.status.self_ready: Updater is downloaded; fully quit to install.
folkways_updater.status.official_unavail: GitHub verification metadata is unavailable through the selected routes. Check direct and mirror access; current files retained.
folkways_updater.config.self_help: Update this updater independently of local development mode. Local mode does not disable self-updates.
folkways_updater.status.self_no_target: This IDE run has no installed updater JAR to replace.
folkways_updater.status.self_verificatio: Updater verification metadata is unavailable after trying the configured routes; current updater retained. Folkways follows its own settings.
folkways_updater.status.settings_changed: Settings applied; Folkways and updater checks follow their independent switches.
folkways_updater.status.dependency_confl: Prerequisite %s conflicts: installed %s, required %s. Files retained; resolve the conflict and check again.
folkways_updater.status.checking_source: Checking %s / %s; latest settings queued. Please wait for verification and downloads...
folkways_updater.status.unproven_overrid: Cannot verify the installed %s override of a bundled library; files retained.
folkways_updater.status.source_ci_unavai: No successful publishing CI matches the selected release commit; installation paused.
folkways_updater.status.source_changed: The selected release changed during download; current files retained. Check again.
folkways_updater.status.folkways_current: Folkways is current for this source (%s).
folkways_updater.status.folkways_ready_c: Folkways %s and prerequisites are ready; fully quit to install.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_title: Take over Folkways for this update?
folkways_updater.config.takeover_message:
Source: %s / %s
Modules: %s

Take ownership of recognizable Folkways files and download the full selected module set. After the game fully exits, back up before replacing. Unknown mods and manual prerequisites are not taken over. Official verification is still required. This authorization applies only to this selection; future checks retain file protection.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_help: Confirm one takeover of existing unmanaged Folkways. Download first; back up and replace after exit. Official verification remains required.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_local: Local development prevents taking over Folkways. Turn it off and save in Basic settings first. Updater self-checks remain independent.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_signed: Takeover requires an official GitHub source. Signed manifest ownership remains protected.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_request: Saved; verifying and downloading this one-time takeover selection.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_queued: Saved; this takeover is queued. Saving another selection cancels its authorization.
folkways_updater.config.takeover_error: Takeover could not be queued. Check local mode, signed-source settings and configuration permissions, then confirm again. Existing files retained.
folkways_updater.status.checking_takeove: Taking over %s / %s for this round; official verification required. Backup and installation wait for exit...
folkways_updater.status.takeover_unselec: Existing %s is outside this selection. Takeover cancelled. Select that module or move it out manually before confirming again.
folkways_updater.status.takeover_composi: Existing %s is in a composite or nested JAR and cannot be safely taken over separately. Files retained.
folkways_updater.status.takeover_signed: This takeover is unavailable for a signed manifest source. Existing ownership remains protected.
